chatTail: Welcome to Gielinor Hero.
Use WASD / Arrows or Click anywhere to move, fight monsters, chop trees, mine ores, or fish.
You arrive with nothing. The tracker under your health shows your first task: speak with the task master in the courtyard.
The courtyard holds the Bank booth, the General Store, and the Anvil. Walk up to use them. Press F1–F6 to switch panels and Esc to close a window.
